item.title: Blackpink's Jennie buys former Iraqi Embassy in Korea for $13 million
item.description: ALBAWABA - Recent reports indicate that Blackpink star Jennie purchased a building that was formerly used as the Iraqi Embassy in Seoul for a whopping 20 billion won (approximately $13.9 million) in cash. According to the Chosun Daily, citing the Ministry of Land, Jennie acquired the building located in Dongbinggo-dong, Yongsan district, on May 24 last year. item.title: Saudi king replaces investment minister in Vision 2030 reset
item.description: ALBAWABA- Saudi Arabia’s King Salman bin Abdulaziz has reshuffled the kingdom’s investment leadership as Riyadh recalibrates its ambitious Vision 2030 reform program.In a royal decree issued on Thursday, Khalid bin Abdulaziz Al-Falih was relieved of his duties as Minister of Investment and reassigned as Minister of State and member of the Council of Ministers.
